itemGradeProvenance.notes: All catalog grades match the current local game export. Grade colors remain visible when selected; selection uses a checkmark. The extractor calls grade 4 red; its in-game database frame is orange.

buffs.name: Seafood Cron Meal
buffs.notes: Simple all-round food for mastery, EXP, weight, and gathering speed. Replaces ordinary food buffs, including Fig Pie.

provenance.evidence: Local exported game item description and effects; no invented icon.

buffs.effectText:
A melt-in-your-mouth dish of soft cheese and fresh seafood.

- Usage: Gain the following effects

- Effects:
   Alchemy/Cooking Time -0.6 sec
   Life EXP +10%
   Processing Success Rate +10%
   Gathering Speed +2
   Movement Speed +2
   Fishing Speed +2
   Weight Limit +250 LT
   Life Skill Mastery +25

- Duration: 120 min
- Cooldown: 10 sec

※ Type: High-quality food
※ High-quality food effects do not stack with other food effects, except Health EXP gain.
※ Only the effects of the last high-quality food used will be applied.

- How to Obtain: Processing ({KeyBind:Manufacture}) - Simple Cooking with the following ingredients

- Ingredients #1:
Balenos Meal x3
Calpheon Meal x3
Margoria Seafood Meal x1
Ancient Cron Spice x1

- Ingredients #2:
Savory Steak x1
Balenos Meal x3
Sute Tea x3
Ancient Cron Spice x1

※ Higher grade versions of the same food item can be used as a substitute at a 1:3 ratio.

stackingNotes: Totals are selected active buff contributions only, not your final character stats. Durations do not add together and selecting a buff does not apply it in game.
Ability levels (gathering, movement, attack speed, critical hit) are different from percentage bonuses. The game ability level cap is 5; excess selected levels are not extra speed.
Cron Meals replace other food effects. Ordinary Fig Pie and Whale Meat Salad can coexist, but the 30-minute food cooldown still applies. Two Fig Pie tiers never add together.
One draught replaces ordinary elixir buffs. Different elixir families can coexist without a draught, but duplicate tiers of the same family cannot. Perfumes are separate.
Only the last perfume applies. Spirit Perfume Elixir is now named Perfume of Spirits in the current client.
Life alchemy/spirit stones exclude other Life stones. Current descriptions allow one Life stone together with a Destruction/Protection type; this catalog has one optional Destruction stone.
Book of Life and Extra Life EXP Scroll share one effect and cannot stack. Mercenary Life has its own family: choose either 50% or 150%. Secret Book of Old Moon is a separate account effect.
Giovan Grolin Support Scroll and Lara Warm Black Tea explicitly stack with other buffs. Tea is not blocked by the ordinary food group.

Blessing of Mystic Beasts and Event Life Skill Scrolls I/II replace residence furniture effects; only the latest furniture-family buff applies. Turning Gates entries are alternative durations of the same Villa buff.
Normal Item Drop Rate (for example Kamasylve Blessing and monster loot scrolls) must not be renamed or added to Gathering Item Drop Rate.
Food and stone names are current-client names. Event availability is not guaranteed; event items are offered only so owned buffs can be recorded.

presets.name: Matchlock · basic elixirs
presets.notes: Starter buff contributions, not a complete +5 build. Gear/guild must supply the remaining attack-speed and critical-hit levels. Change perfumes if needed.

presets.name: Sniper · simple elixirs
presets.notes: A practical sniper selection from the current Garmoth guide. Check gathering-speed level 5 with guild/gear, or add Worker elixir. No critical/back-attack elixirs.

limitations: Not a gear planner: equipped mastery, guild skills, pets, crystals, artifacts, Black Spirit buffs and other unlisted effects must not be assumed included.
No profitability claim is made from added drop rate or mastery. Not all gathering modifiers affect all hunting loot.
No potion consumption, cooldown scheduling, or automatic buff detection. This records what the user selected.
Current game-export effects and descriptions take priority over older community guide values. The original item tooltips remain the final reference.
Event buff catalog is intentionally small. Short-lived giveaways and unverified effects are omitted.
